user_goal.text: Determine how many activities are completed in the user's bucket-list SimpleNote note.

benchmark_success.rationale: Native success requires every registered TestTracker test to pass.

checked_by.text: The frozen AppWorld TestTracker applies the case's evaluate function and reports success when its pass count equals its registered-test count.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official TestTracker result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered no-model-changes test passed because the changed-model set was empty?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The retained submitted answer and evaluator comparison result determine this test.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_818d3311397a] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert no model changes.
success_if.rationale: The retained start/end database diff and evaluator result determine whether the changed-model set was empty.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A failed retained evaluator comparison determines failure of this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_818d3311397a] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert no model changes.
fail_if.rationale: A retained diff showing any changed model, together with the evaluator result, determines failure of this registered test.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
